name: Garbage disposal
scene: Hangs under a kitchen sink drain inside the base cabinet. Show the cabinet floor, back wall and one side wall, the counter with the sink basin above (built from walls so the drain is visible from above), the faucet, the supply valves and the P-trap running to the wall drain. Leave the front and right open.
size: Unit 0.30-0.40 m tall and 0.17-0.22 m across; its top is at the sink bottom, about 0.65-0.72 m above the cabinet floor. Counter at about 0.9 m.

parts.label: Disposal
parts.describe: The unit: a mostly cylindrical housing, wider grind chamber on top, motor below, often black, grey or stainless with a label band. Cut away the upper chamber (lathe sweep 270) to show the grinding plate.

parts.label: Splash guard
parts.describe: Black rubber disc with radial slits sitting in the sink drain opening, pulls straight up out of the drain.

parts.label: Grinding plate
parts.describe: Steel turntable inside the chamber with two swivel impeller lugs; turns when freed.

parts.label: Stuck food
parts.describe: Debris jamming the plate: food scraps, a bone, a fruit pit. A clump child of the grinding plate.

parts.label: Wrench socket
parts.describe: 1/4 inch hex hole in the centre of the bottom for the jam-buster wrench.

parts.label: Reset button
parts.describe: Small red push button on the bottom near the edge.

parts.label: Power plug
parts.describe: Cord from the bottom to an outlet on the back wall (or a hard-wired box); the plug pulls straight out.

parts.label: P-trap
parts.describe: White PVC or chrome U-bend under the discharge tube with slip nuts; drops down when the nuts are loosened.

parts.label: Discharge tube
parts.describe: Elbow from the side of the unit into the trap.

parts.label: Mounting ring
parts.describe: Ring with three lugs at the top that twists to release the unit.

parts.label: Dishwasher inlet
parts.describe: Side nipple near the top where the dishwasher drain hose clamps on (knock-out plug inside on new units).

parts.label: Wall switch
parts.describe: Switch above the counter or an air switch button on the counter.

debris: grime patch under the splash guard
standing water in the sink (a water plane) when it will not drain
views: from above into the sink drain
from below for the bottom of the unit
notes: The disposal, sink drain and P-trap line up on one vertical axis behind the cabinet centre. Unplug before reaching in.
